// why: The register of the file-structure gate, with an internal entry that has outlived the exception it was written for.

inline.reason: The host IS the native input: the component projects nothing and renders nothing of its own, so its template is the empty string. A file holding it would hold no characters, and a reader opening `text.html` to see what the control draws would learn less than the decorator tells them.

internal.reason: The wrapper's own drawing unit, and the entrypoint's index says nothing about it on purpose: no input, output or public method of `FxField` carries the type, so a consumer has no expression in which they could need the name. It leaves the internal list the day a public signature names it.
Written while the variant union was still the button's own business, and left standing after `index.ts` began exporting `./button.types` in the same afternoon.
